premise: Nico teases Turtle for crawling so slowly on the sand; she challenges him to a race in the sea and swims past him like a bird through the sky.
inspiration: Aesop's tortoise and hare, turned inside out: the slow one is fast in her own place, and the teasing ends in admiration.
learning: Sea turtles are slow on the sand but swift in the water.

en-US.title: Slow on Sand, Fast in Sea
en-US.text: {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Turtle was crawling across the sand. Flip… flop… ever so slowly. {surfer:enter} Nico came by with his yellow board. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [playfully] "Turtle, you're SO slow!" {turtle:live} Turtle tucked her head in, and peeked out again, smiling. [playfully] On land, I'm slow, she said. But in the water? Race you! {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] "You're on!" {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelican landed on the rocks to watch. {pelican:pulse} Ready, steady… GO! {surfer:go to sea by surf} Nico paddled out and stood up on his board. {turtle:go to sea by swim} Turtle slid into the water and WHOOSH! She flew through the waves like a bird through the sky. {pelican:live} Pelican was so amazed he scooped up a beakful of water. [laughs] By the time Nico rode a wave {surfer:go to sand by surf} back in, Turtle was already waiting. {turtle:hearts} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [laughs] "Okay, Turtle. es-ES.title: Lenta en tierra, rápida nadando
es-ES.text: {turtle:enter} {turtle:go to sand} Tortuga cruzaba la arena arrastrándose. Flip… flop… despacito, despacito. {surfer:enter} Nico pasó con su tabla amarilla. {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [playfully] «¡Tortuga, qué LENTA eres!» {turtle:live} Tortuga escondió la cabeza y la volvió a asomar, sonriendo. [playfully] En tierra soy lenta, dijo. ¿Pero en el agua? ¡Te echo una carrera! {surfer:face surprised} {surfer:says} [excited] «¡Vale!» {pelican:enter} {pelican:go to rocks} Pelícano se posó en las rocas para mirar. {pelican:pulse} Preparados, listos… ¡YA! {surfer:go to sea by surf} Nico remó y se puso de pie en su tabla. {turtle:go to sea by swim} Tortuga se deslizó en el agua y ¡FIUUU! Volaba entre las olas como un pájaro por el cielo. {pelican:live} Pelícano se quedó tan asombrado que recogió un buen trago de agua. [laughs] Cuando Nico volvió cogiendo una ola {surfer:go to sand by surf} hasta la arena, Tortuga ya lo estaba esperando. {turtle:hearts} {surfer:face happy} {surfer:says} [laughs] «Vale, Tortuga. ¡Eres la que nada más rápido de aquí!» {surfer:hop}
